battlecards.why_selected: Provided 3.15% fee tier matching market benchmarks and agreed to apply rates retroactively without requiring long-term extension beyond current term.
battlecards.contract_terms: Rates reduced to 3.15% of collections through current contract ending Jan-2025; addendum provides retroactive credit back to 9/1/22; no extension required.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Benchmark data showing fees 50–70 bps above market and threat to issue RFP six months before 2025 expiration despite $9M termination penalty.
battlecards.switching_costs: System migration, data conversion, workflow retraining, potential $9M termination penalty.

battlecards.why_selected: Lowest overall basket pricing in BAFO round, committed on-site resources, accepted 60-day payment terms and formulary compliance reporting.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year master distribution agreement with two 1-year renewals; price caps not to exceed CPI-U; quarterly business reviews with rebate true-ups.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Enterprise-wide volume commitment (>150 locations) and ability to shift Heartland business away from Medline.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher freight charges on low-unit orders (mitigated via minimum order policy)
battlecards.switching_costs: Catalog mapping, EDI integration, clinician product familiarity.
battlecards.notes: Primary distributor for all regions post-10/31/22.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pricing remained >8% above McKesson’s BAFO and would not extend payment terms beyond Net 30.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of losing enterprise contract; Medline offered selective discounts but insufficient.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher pricing, unwilling to lengthen payment terms
battlecards.switching_costs: Some product conversions and system updates required but outweighed by savings.
battlecards.notes: Will continue as secondary source until inventory rundown completed.

battlecards.why_selected: Met price targets within operational change tolerance; maintained existing phlebotomy staffing and LIS interfaces.
battlecards.contract_terms: 2-year price lock with 30-day implementation; quarterly price review allowed only downward adjustments.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest quote showed 19% savings; LabCorp matched many high-volume CPT codes to retain business.
supplier_weaknesses: Higher pricing on niche tests relative to Quest
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-credentialing, specimen courier logistics, payer notifications.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Operational disruption judged too high despite highest savings; would require switching all Mid-Atlantic draw stations.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest’s aggressive pricing used to pressure LabCorp.
supplier_weaknesses: No existing phlebotomy staff, interface build required
battlecards.switching_costs: System interface, staff transition, payer realignment.

battlecards.why_selected: Provides flexible 20% overflow coverage while in-house recruiting ramps; cost competitive vs. IT Imaging billable rate.
battlecards.contract_terms: 12-month agreement, $72/hr bill rate, no minimum hours, 15-day termination for convenience.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Volume projection of ~750 scans/month and visibility to internal cost model.
supplier_weaknesses: Limited clinical oversight; requires Advantia credentialing
battlecards.switching_costs: Low—agency arrangement can be exited with 15-day notice.
battlecards.notes: Target utilization 20%; remainder handled by newly hired Advantia sonographers.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Could not meet benchmark rates; unwilling to guarantee staffing levels; sub-optimal pay per scan model.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Benchmarks showed 18-24% savings potential by insourcing.
supplier_weaknesses: High cost per scan, limited scheduling flexibility
battlecards.switching_costs: Transition planning for open requisitions and patient scheduling.
battlecards.notes: Contract allowed termination with 60-day notice which was exercised.

alternatives_considered: Optimize mix with AbbVie Liletta (analysis showed minimal benefit)
battlecards.why_selected: Retained due to deepest USWHA tier discounts and product familiarity.
battlecards.contract_terms: USWHA tier pricing unlocked by minimum 5-unit orders; discounts effective 7/11/22 onward.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Demonstrated historical non-compliance with MOQ resulting in 0% discounts; enforcing policy unlocked immediate savings.
supplier_weaknesses: High WAC relative to competitor products
battlecards.switching_costs: Clinical equivalence trials, patient marketing, inventory write-offs.
battlecards.notes: Separate ‘Confidence in Coverage’ rebate program adds additional $21.6K savings.
